claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted custody decision affecting client crypto-assets MUST evidence segregation from the CASP's own assets. Decisions with unproven segregation are refused at the action-admissibility gate.
Every AI-assisted withdrawal or transfer of custodied crypto-assets MUST map to a named custody-control owner with the prescribed authority. Absent designation refuses the decision.

Every material custody decision attributable to the safekeeping obligation MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable Evidence Pack binding owner identity, MiCA Article discharged, and Authority Finality outcome.
Every AI-assisted key-management or signing-key action MUST satisfy dual control. Single-actor key operations are refused and routed dual-channel to the custody-control owner.
